purpose: Deterministic authority for deciding whether a change invalidates, rebinds, merely reconciles, or preserves previously sealed audit evidence.

effectClasses.INVALIDATES: Evidence remains historical but MUST NOT support the changed target until replacement/retest evidence is accepted.
effectClasses.REQUIRES_REBIND: Prior evidence remains valid only for its original execution/release identity; new execution claims require exact rebind and new evidence.
effectClasses.RECONCILE_ONLY: Raw evidence is not automatically stale, but affected traceability/property/finding relationships must be reassessed before reuse.
effectClasses.PRESERVES: No technical evidence invalidation when the stated no-semantic-change condition is proven; record the classification and proof.

universalProcedure: Detect and classify every material change event before EVIDENCE_SEALED.
Apply every matching rule; if multiple rules apply, the strictest applicable effect controls the affected evidence set.
Create a stable INV-* node in SECURITY_TRACEABILITY_GRAPH for every nontrivial change event and connect INVALIDATES/DEPENDS_ON/REMEDIATES/REGRESSION_TESTS relationships as applicable.
Never delete stale evidence; mark it HISTORICAL_STALE_FOR_CURRENT_TARGET and preserve its immutable identity.
Create OBL-* records for required retest/rebind/reconciliation work that is due in a later phase.
If applicability is uncertain, classify conservatively as RECONCILE_ONLY or INVALIDATES rather than silently preserving evidence.
Phase 9 remediation must explicitly reconcile this matrix against the remediation delta ledger.
Phase 10 cannot rely on evidence with unresolved invalidation/rebind obligations.

detectWhen: any in-scope production source byte changes
source family fence changes for an affected contract
evidenceAffected: finding reproduction and assurance claims relying on affected source
Canonical Source Intelligence facts bound to affected production source
evidencePreserved: prior immutable evidence as historical provenance
unaffected independently fenced source-family evidence after explicit reconciliation
requiredActions: reopen/re-execute only affected required work according to controller invalidation
create replacement evidence and regression obligations
generate and accept a new Source Intelligence version from the exact template for the changed source/build

evidenceAffected: fuzz/simulation evidence whose compiled artifact changed
evidencePreserved: source-only manual reasoning not dependent on compiled semantics, after explicit reconciliation
requiredActions: regenerate affected Source Intelligence sections/version for the new build identity

evidenceAffected: failed execution that required runner repair
Phase-1 static-recon Source Intelligence layer when the relevant analyzer/tool changed
evidencePreserved: accepted prior evidence bound to its original exact runner/tool identity unless another rule invalidates it
requiredActions: rerun the operation that depends on the repaired/new implementation

detectWhen: target input bounds or deploy/config fixtures materially change
evidenceAffected: campaign results produced by the materially changed harness/model
evidencePreserved: unaffected campaigns using unchanged immutable harnesses
production source evidence
requiredActions: retain prior campaign as historical comparison

evidenceAffected: fork/lifecycle simulations tied to old configuration
integration/reachability assumptions tied to old configuration
evidencePreserved: source-only evidence not dependent on changed deployment/config after explicit reconciliation
requiredActions: update traceability and finding impact where applicable

evidenceAffected: state/balance/storage assumptions at the old fork identity
evidencePreserved: non-fork evidence that does not depend on the changed state identity
requiredActions: do not compare results as equivalent without explicit differential analysis

evidenceAffected: reachability/impact claims using old dependency behavior
evidencePreserved: unrelated source and execution evidence
requiredActions: invalidate/rerun any evidence that actually relied on changed behavior
create downstream obligations where execution is required

detectWhen: fixes or remediation patches modify production source/config
evidenceAffected: validated finding reproduction on modified surfaces
Canonical Source Intelligence for modified source/build surfaces
evidencePreserved: unaffected findings/evidence after explicit diff-based reconciliation
requiredActions: record replacement evidence in Phase 9 remediation ledger
generate a new Source Intelligence version for the remediated source/build before structural reuse

detectWhen: material ASSUMP-* is disproved or replaced
evidenceAffected: traceability edges and downstream evidence disposition for the changed model item
evidencePreserved: raw immutable evidence whose observed behavior remains accurate
requiredActions: reassess whether existing evidence still tests the changed property/hypothesis
create new test/simulation obligation when coverage no longer matches

detectWhen: only comments/docs/readmes/non-executable prose changed and exact diff proves no runtime/config/interface semantic change
evidencePreserved: all technical evidence

detectWhen: report wording/layout/formatting changes without changing finding facts, source identity, evidence identity, severity rationale, or assurance claim semantics
evidencePreserved: all underlying audit evidence

detectWhen: audit orchestration/report routing changes without changing target source or trusted technical execution semantics
evidencePreserved: accepted immutable technical evidence bound to unchanged source/execution identities
requiredActions: bind new controller/skill identity before new progression
do not rerun technical evidence solely because orchestration prose changed

detectWhen: human returns a phase for rework
a newer phase revision supersedes an older report
evidencePreserved: immutable underlying evidence unless another rule invalidates it
requiredActions: reconcile accepted underlying evidence into new report without silently deleting history

detectWhen: runtime/deployment overlay bytes differ from the bundle-index accepted SHA-256
deployment address, implementation, admin, role, oracle, cross-chain endpoint, chain/fork, or block identity changes
canonical mutable path resolves to a revision other than latestAcceptedRevision

Phase-8/9/10 conclusions relying on those runtime facts

unchanged immutable Source Intelligence core after exact source/build reconciliation

validate and commit any replacement overlay revision
update the bundle index only after revision/digest acceptance

detectWhen: harness, test, invariant, tool, configuration, dictionary, corpus, skeleton, or model identity/bytes change

unaffected deployable estimates with independently matching identities
